pattern.description: Macro live-action insert: a finger presses the floor-12 button, whose rim lights red, while the camera eases back slightly.
pattern.why_premium: Shallow-focus macro on a tactile press with a light-up confirmation reads as a precise 'action triggered' beat, and the gentle pull-out keeps the close-up from feeling static.

build_hint.gsap: Footage clip on a hard cut; camera feel: tl.fromTo(clip, {scale: 1.04, x: 0}, {scale: 1, x: '-3%', duration: 0.4, ease: 'power2.out'}); for a recreated button: tl.to(buttonRim, {borderColor: '#c0392b', duration: 0.1, ease: 'none'}, 0.1).
build_hint.remotion: <Sequence> with <OffthreadVideo>; scale interpolate(frame, [0, 10], [1.04, 1], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.quad)}); rim colour via interpolateColors(frame, [2, 5], ['#7fa7c9', '#c0392b']).

notes: Live-action footage with a camera pull_out verdict (slight scale-down and leftward drift), folded into the b01 change types since the schema has no camera field.
